items.html: And it is possible that blessing and freedom and to sustain everything — these three are: sons, life, and sustenance: sons, that is blessing, to bring out blessings to the Matronita through the Yesod, as it is taught here. Sustenance, that is freedom. Life, that is to sustain everything. And these three are not dependent on merit, which is Hesed, but are dependent on the Mazal — their union, to bring out sons, life, and sustenance to the world that is to come; and from there they are drawn to the holy King; and then it is written, 'with the crown with which his mother crowned him,' in the secret of his six extremities, which spread and shine in him throughout all his six extremities. And this is the matter of 'it spreads to its sides,' and springs and streams that are within Bina go out; and this son inherits the inheritance of his father and his mother, and the two crowns that were hidden in AVI, and now he inherits them, as is stated in the Idra Zuta.
